description: Implementation of AuditReadPlatformService, providing methods to retrieve audit log entries, both listing and paginated, as well as processing audit data details and search templates within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: AuditReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of AuditReadPlatformService. Provides mechanisms for fetching audit log entries, details, and templates, incorporating permissions and data enrichment logic.

classes.name: AuditMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for converting SQL query results into AuditData objects, including schema generating method.

classes.name: ActionNamesMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for extracting action names from SQL result set.

classes.name: EntityNamesMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for extracting entity names from SQL result set.

classes.name: ProcessingResultsMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping processing result status entries from database.

methods.name: retrieveAuditEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent audit entries with optional JSON command details.

methods.name: retrievePaginatedAuditEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of audit entries based on provided parameters, including sorting and filtering.

methods.name: retrieveAllEntriesToBeChecked
methods.description: Fetches audit entries that are pending review or checked, with JSON command details.

methods.name: retrieveAuditEntry
methods.description: Fetches detailed audit entry information by audit ID, with enriched command JSON.

methods.name: retrieveSearchTemplate
methods.description: Provides templates for searching audit logs, including action names, entity names, and processing results.

search-terms: enrich audit data with entity names
